data.predicted_state: Fix Hue Bridge brightness reports while dimming
data.z2m_color_modes: Fix colors of full-color Zigbee2MQTT lights

data_description.predicted_state: When dimming starts, Hue Bridges report 0% or 100% brightness and only snap back to a light's actual brightness after ~10 s. This setting shows the starting brightness in Home Assistant when dimming starts, and the light's actual brightness when it stops. Disable the setting to get the raw bridge reports.
data_description.z2m_color_modes: Full color lights use both XY and HS modes, but Zigbee2MQTT announces them as XY mode only. This causes Home Assistant to ignore reports from full color lights in HS mode. This setting overrides Z2M and announces both modes to HA. Turn it off to revert to Z2M's native behavior.
data_description.experimental_features: Lets DeviceSide try features not yet proven on your device. Whether they work or not, please tell us with Report a device test result or bug in DeviceSide's options.

report_device.title: Report a device test result or bug

propose_device.description: Choose the light or switch you're proposing, and DeviceSide will prefill its details. Proposals need a known YAML solution, running stably on your Home Assistant, that you're willing to share.

get_attributes.name: Get attributes
get_attributes.description: Read a device's brightness, color temp, color (RGB, HS, XY), running on/off timers and auto-off/auto-on settings, even when the device is off. Returns one record per target.

limit.name: Minimum brightness limit
limit.description: Light turns off at 0%. Choose 0.4%+ to keep light on.

lower_hue.name: Lower hue
lower_hue.description: Start decreasing the hue angle: red to magenta to blue to green, wrapping at 360°. It cycles until a stop action.

sweep_time.name: Sweep time
sweep_time.description: Duration of a 360° color wheel rotation.

lower_saturation.name: Lower saturation
lower_saturation.description: Start lowering the saturation, to make the color paler.

raise_hue.name: Raise hue
raise_hue.description: Start increasing the hue angle: red to yellow to green to blue, wrapping at 360°. It cycles until a stop action.

sweep_time.name: Sweep time
sweep_time.description: Duration of a 360° color wheel rotation.

raise_saturation.name: Raise saturation
raise_saturation.description: Start raising saturation, to make the color richer.

set_attributes.name: Set attributes
set_attributes.description: Set brightness, color temp, or color without changing on/off state.

set_auto_off.name: Set auto-off
set_auto_off.description: Turn off automatically after every turn-on. Stored on the device. Clear auto-off removes it.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to stay on before turning off.

set_auto_on.name: Set auto-on
set_auto_on.description: Turn on automatically after every turn-off. Stored on the device. Clear auto-on removes it.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to stay off before turning on.

set_scene.name: Set scene
set_scene.description: Set a Hue scene without turning on its lights.

turn_off_for.name: Turn off with timer
turn_off_for.description: Devices turn off, then on again after a delay.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to stay off before turning on.

turn_on_for.name: Turn on with timer
turn_on_for.description: Devices turn on, then off again after a delay.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to stay on before turning off.

hs_color.name: Hue/Sat color
hs_color.description: Color in hue/sat format. A list of two numbers: hue 0-360, saturation 0-100.

rgb_color.name: Color
rgb_color.description: Color in RGB format. A list of three integers between 0 and 255.

xy_color.name: XY-color
xy_color.description: Color in XY format. A list of two decimal numbers between 0 and 1.
